verses.1: The one who saw the vision of the prophet.
verses.2: Until Anah hears from Jehovah, I will not cry out to you. The horn will not be heard, and you will not save me.
verses.3: Why do they look at me with envy and hatred? They see me as an enemy. There will be strife and conflict between us.
verses.4: Therefore, righteousness will be destroyed, and there will be no lasting judgment. For the wicked will accuse the righteous. Thus, judgment will be unjust.
verses.5: Look at the nations, and see what they do. Be careful, for each action they carry out in your time, do not believe it unless it is truly true.
verses.6: For I am building those traps, those evil people who are greedy and quick to go into the wilderness, to take over those places where there are no inhabitants.
verses.7: May he be blessed and honored by his judgment and decision.
verses.8: And they were freed from their riders and from those who rushed upon them in the evening. Their wings were spread wide, and they came from far away. They rushed forward like wild beasts in search of food.
verses.9: All of them rushed forward from their positions, and they gathered together like a crowd.
verses.10: And he was praised among the kings. They played games with him; he was a source of joy for everyone. He gathered up all the birds and held them captive.
verses.11: Then, a spirit passed by, and this power was given to the Lord.
verses.12: Do not be late, O LORD my God! You are holy. Do not abandon the laws that You have established; let them remain firm and unchanging.
verses.13: Tahor’s eyes saw only evil. He looked at Amal, but he couldn’t bear to look at those who were evil. He refused to be part of their actions. He was righteous and did not want to be involved with those who were evil.
verses.14: And man was made like the fish of the sea, like a creature that cannot control itself.
verses.15: All of them, in their patience, will be gathered together in a single place. Then they will be rejoiced and praised.
verses.16: Therefore, he will be destroyed and punished for his actions. For in that animal, he shares a part of its life and its food.
verses.17: May he be destroyed forever, and may he always cause death to nations. He will never be able to live in peace.
